facts.fact: Governor Felisberto Navalha said the Assembly of the Republic approved the new National Payment System Law, which covers price and fee disclosure, consumer protection, competition, innovation, oversight and security of transactions; no start date is given.
The governor said METIX, Mozambique's first instant payment system, launched in March 2026 and averaged about 12,000 transactions a day by October 2026, up from about 3,000 at launch.
The governor spoke of progress in access to financial services through interoperability between banks and mobile money institutions.
